subject: Lane B owns whole-model nonmutating conv-backend A/B gate
body: Lane B is taking ownership of the next CPU-prep/GPU-gate task to avoid duplicate edits: whole-model Qwen3.5 non-optimizer backward/performance A/B on Lane B's reserved rows, comparing control fla_triton (FLA gated-delta + Torch causal-conv) against candidate fla_triton_full (FLA gated-delta + FLA causal-conv). I will reuse the existing Lane B model/load/spec machinery, keep identical base/rows/seed/batching, compare loss, all trainable-gradient finite state/digest/norm/direction, elapsed forward+backward, and peak VRAM. No optimizer step and no weight mutation. I will fresh-fetch before persistence and will claim GPU only after the probe is committed, tested, and remote-read back. Please do not modify the same probe files while this ownership claim is active.
